item.title: Too big to review? Critic Kate Copstick's view on the modern 'Edinburgh Fringe'
item.description: The Edinburgh Fringe is one of the world's latest performing arts festival with thousands of shows. NPR's Scott Simon talks to the critic Kate Copstick about the challenges of covering the event.

item.title: A tale of two very different horny movies
item.description: One Night Only manages to fail as a dystopia and as a rom-com. Meanwhile, Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma is a perfect tale for this moment — if you don't mind your eroticism with a side of gore.

item.title: The new movie about Anthony Bourdain is none of the things you fear it could be
item.description: The internationally known chef, writer, and television star died in 2018. Tony, starring Dominic Sessa, tells just a splinter of Bourdain's life — the mid-1970s summer when he was 19.

item.title: The park service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be moved?
item.description: President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.

item.description: Living in the desert is "not for everybody," says Watkins. Her home, in the Mojave Desert near Death Valley, is staggeringly beautiful and brutal. Her new novel Yellow Pine shares this landscape.

item.description: The new Hulu series stars Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent on the trail of a serial killer. It was inspired by Black Widow, but Furious totally transforms the 1987 film.

item.title: How one negative Google review led to the New Bedford Whaling Museum to go viral
item.description: After a a Google user left a one-star review of the New Bedford Whaling Museum, calling it the "worst Aquarium Ever," the museum created merch with the phrase on it that has gone viral.
